requisiteText:
To enrol in this course you must:

be enrolled in VMGNT - Master of Management (Advanced); and,
have approval from an ANU academic to supervise the MMIB8006 research thesis; and,
completed MGMT8006; and,
completed MGMT8018 or MGMT8019 or MKTG8060.
OR have the permission of the VMGNT - Master of Management (Advanced) Program Convenor.
